notes: Official cassandra:5 image, 3 nodes RF=3, LOCAL_QUORUM by default. Query-first schema (one table per access path), SAI indexes for vector (ANN) and analyzed text search, LWT for compare-and-set, counter table for increments. Nodes are addressed by static container IPs (10.99.1.11-13); the client is pinned to one node per target.

secondary_index.title: Create a secondary index on a non-key field and use it
secondary_index.detail: SAI index on orders(status): 1000 rows fetched via the index (global index; Scylla: materialized-view based)

compound_index.title: Compound / composite index over two fields
compound_index.detail: no multi-column index; compound access paths are modelled as (partition key, clustering columns) of a query table

unique_constraint.title: Unique constraint on a non-key field (duplicate rejected)
unique_constraint.detail: INSERT ... IF NOT EXISTS (LWT) on the primary key only; no unique constraint on other columns

ttl_expiry.title: Native per-document/key expiry
ttl_expiry.detail: USING TTL per write / default_time_to_live per table

text_index.title: Full-text index with tokenised search
text_index.detail: no analyzed text index (Cassandra 5 SAI has one; Scylla/YCQL do not)

vector_index.title: Vector (ANN) index and kNN query
vector_index.detail: vector<float, 8> column + SAI index + ORDER BY ... ANN OF

partial_update.title: Update a single field without rewriting the document

atomic_increment.title: Server-side atomic numeric increment
atomic_increment.detail: counter column: UPDATE ... SET qty = qty + 1 -> [(364,)]

optimistic_concurrency.title: Compare-and-set / version or ETag-guarded write
optimistic_concurrency.detail: lightweight transaction (Paxos / Raft): UPDATE ... IF version = ? -> [(1, 3)]

multi_doc_transaction.title: Multi-document / multi-key ACID transaction with rollback
multi_doc_transaction.detail: conditional BATCH within one partition (atomic, isolated); LOGGED BATCH across partitions is atomic but not isolated; no rollback API

tunable_consistency.title: Per-request consistency / write concern / read preference
tunable_consistency.detail: per-statement consistency level: ANY/ONE/QUORUM/LOCAL_QUORUM/EACH_QUORUM/ALL (+ SERIAL for LWT)

nested_query.title: Filter on a field inside a nested object
nested_query.detail: no nested documents: UDTs/collections are opaque to WHERE except CONTAINS; flatten or use SAI on UDT fields

array_operators.title: Query and update array-valued fields (contains, push)
array_operators.detail: set/list/map collections with += / -= updates, CONTAINS (index or ALLOW FILTERING) -> 1

aggregation.title: Server-side group-by aggregation
aggregation.detail: GROUP BY only on partition/clustering key prefix; COUNT/SUM/AVG over one partition or with ALLOW FILTERING (full scan)

server_side_join.title: Join / lookup between two collections inside the engine
server_side_join.detail: no joins: denormalise (one table per query) or join client-side / in Spark

schema_validation.title: Server-enforced document schema / constraints
schema_validation.detail: typed columns enforced by the schema (no constraints beyond types/keys)

change_streams.title: Change feed / watch / keyspace notifications
change_streams.detail: CDC (Cassandra: commit-log segments read by an external agent; Scylla: CDC log table queryable with CQL)

server_side_scripting.title: Stored procedures / Lua / JS / UDF executed by the server
server_side_scripting.detail: UDFs: Error from server: code=2200 [Invalid query] message="User-defined functions are disabled in cassand

pubsub.title: Publish/subscribe messaging built into the engine
pubsub.detail: no pub/sub (CDC log tables for change capture)

explain_plan.title: Query plan / profile output for a query

bulk_import.title: Native bulk import path (bulk API, batch, COPY-like tool)
bulk_import.detail: COPY FROM (cqlsh), sstableloader, DSBulk / concurrent prepared statements (driver)

large_document.title: Store and read back a 15 MB document / value
large_document.detail: 15 MB text cell ok (max_mutation_size default 16 MB = half commitlog_segment_size)

many_fields.title: Document with 5000 top-level fields
many_fields.detail: columns are schema-defined (5000 ALTER TABLE ADD is possible but pathological); use a map<text,text> for sparse attributes

read_from_replica.title: Client can direct reads to a replica / secondary
read_from_replica.detail: leaderless: any replica serves reads (consistency level ONE); driver load balancing spreads requests

snapshot_backup.title: Online snapshot / backup command available
snapshot_backup.detail: nodetool snapshot (per node, hard links) — not a CQL command; Scylla: nodetool snapshot / Scylla Manager
